candidate: key-class decode attention: eight warps per (token, head), one warp per key class, each logit reduced by the shuffle-exact 256-lane tree
reason: bit-exact against the block kernel and faster on both geometries (421-428 us vs 652-700 us sliding, 665-696 us vs 1186 us full at keys=1024), moving the campaign metric to 33.0213 tok/s from 24.5964 (+34.3%) and to +105% over the 16.0931 baseline

mechanism.before: one 256-thread block per (token, head) with the reduction tree spanning its eight warps, so every key costs a shared partial row, three LDS tree rounds, a publish/broadcast pair and a barrier sequence; iteration 20 measured the per-key cost as invariant to the work inside the key iteration, and grid scaling showed the machine ~16x idle
mechanism.after: warp w of eight owns the keys w, w+8, w+16, ... and evaluates each key's whole 256-lane tree with shuffles (lane w owns tree lanes [8w, 8w+8), so strides 128/64/32/16/8 are lane distances 16/8/4/2/1 and strides 4/2/1 are in-lane adds). Pass 1 has no LDS traffic and no barriers. The two cross-warp reductions leave the key walk: each warp publishes its running maximum and the row maximum is the fmaxf of the eight (order-independent, hence bit-exact). Pass 2 and pass 3 are the block kernel's own partitions verbatim.
mechanism.trade: each warp does 8x more tree work per key than the block kernel's distributed tree, but it is issue work rather than a barrier-and-LDS round trip, and 128 warps of concurrency hide it
mechanism.why_this_beats_iteration_21: the warp-per-head kernel removed the same machinery but left 16 warps for a decode step (one per head), which is why it lost at head_dim 256; the key-class kernel keeps the block kernel's 128 warps

correctness.contract: bit-exact with the block kernel (same-schedule arithmetic), not a changed-arithmetic candidate: no production-profile KL gate applies
correctness.parity_result: bitwise equal on every shape, both dtypes, keep and holes masks; green together with tests/test_gpu_gemma4_attention_geometry.py
correctness.routing_test: tests/test_gpu_gemma4_attention_decode_parity.py::test_decode_variant_selection_is_by_geometry - asserts head_dim 512 -> class, 256 -> class, 128/768 -> block through hipengine_gemma4_attention_decode_variant()
correctness.public_path_parity: true on all four re-measured campaign rows

microbench.protocol: one launch per measurement window, 30 iterations, same clock state per comparison, device sync at the end
